ideas.title: Following the money: Uncovering fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the $6.5 million fraud scheme in Minnesota and determine if there are any connections to other entities or individuals
questions: Who is behind the fraud scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. I will follow the money trail to determine the extent of the scheme and identify any other entities or individuals involved.
